sloka: ततः संदिश्य सुग्रीवः श्वशुरम् पश्चिमाम् दिशम् ।वीरम् शतबलिम् नाम वानरम् वानररेश्वर ॥४-४३-१॥
transliteration: tataḥ saṁdiśya sugrīvaḥ śvaśuram paścimām diśam ।vīram śatabalim nāma vānaram vānarareśvara ॥4-43-1॥

translations.english: Sugriva, the bull among monkeys, having sent his fatherinlaw in the western direction, said to Satavali, troop leader of the monkeys:
